News

For all media enquiries, email media@waidc.govt.nz

  • 8 July 2026

    Head Start: Progress on Council Amalgamation

    As we mark Matariki, it's an opportunity to pause, reflect and spend time with those around us. This year's theme, Herenga Waka, celebrates unity, inclusion and the value of bringing people together to share different perspectives.
  • 8 July 2026

    Stories of creativity, culture, and community across Waikato district

    Introducing Creativity Lives in Waikato, a storytelling series celebrating community groups using creativity to strengthen their communities, delivered in partnership with Creative Waikato.
  • 6 July 2026

    Enza’s second chance

    A partnership between Waikato District Council’s Animal Control team, Waikato Pound Pups, Fundraising for Impounded Dogs and GT Vets has helped give the 18-month-old a second chance.
